severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — NOSTALGIA INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: FABRICATED-NOSTALGIA FRONT SETTLES OVER THE FACEBOOK DELTA AS SEPIA-TONED PHOTOS OF CHILDHOODS THAT NEVER OCCURRED CIRCULATE UNDER THE CAPTION 'ONLY 1 IN A MILLION WILL REMEMBER THIS,' A FIGURE THAT IS, FOR ONCE, ACCURATE
advisory: A warm, low-pressure system of manufactured memory has stalled across the residential feeds and is not expected to lift before the weekend. Residents are advised that the pictured 1950s soda fountain, the mittened schoolchildren, and the grandfather in the improbably clean workshop are composites generated at scale to harvest the word 'Amen' and the phrase 'they don't make them like this anymore.' The Service notes that nobody is required to remember something that did not happen. Engagement with the caption 'type 1 to honor the past' is the transmission vector and should be avoided.

regional_outlook.conditions: Saturated. Dense fog of tinted memory hangs at engagement level, with scattered outbreaks of six-fingered grandfathers waving from porches that reflect no known architectural period.
Sepia haze drifting in from the Delta, depositing 'vintage recipe cards' for dishes that were never served. Board saturation high through evening.
Rising tide of 'Remember When' nostalgia anthologies, each 112 pages of confident decades that overlap incorrectly. Bing-Crosby-adjacent, legally distinct.
Newsletter runoff forwarding the Delta's output to older residents with the subject line 'This will make you cry.' Filtering recommended but not guaranteed.
Groundwater contamination as fabricated 'historical photographs' surface in image results and begin quietly presenting themselves as archival record.

specimen.status: Abundant; seasonally aggressive around holidays and Sundays.
specimen.habitat: Comment-heavy community pages, 'On This Day' feeds, and any group with the word 'Simpler' in its name.
specimen.field_marks: Sepia or hand-tinted palette applied uniformly; impossibly tidy interiors; children whose faces are cousins of one another; a caption asserting a memory the viewer is instructed to have. Often accompanied by a decade cited to the year with total confidence and zero sources.
specimen.call: If you remember pumping water by hand before school, type AMEN and share before they take this down.
specimen.confusion_species: Genuine family photographs and real archival images, which are irregularly lit, imperfectly framed, and do not end in a request to comment '1' to prove you were there. When a memory asks you to publicly confirm it, it is soliciting, not remembering.

spotter_tip: Zoom in on the hands and the hardware. A fabricated memory will have too many fingers, a stove with no controls, or a wall clock whose numbers gave up around four o'clock — real nostalgia is blurry in the corners, not in the arithmetic.
tomorrow: Nostalgia front lingers through Friday before an inspirational-quote system moves in from the LinkedIn Plateau; residual sepia possible into the weekend.
